title: Structural details of helix-mediated multimerization of the conserved region of TDP-43 C-terminal domain.
authors: Rizuan, Azamat; Shenoy, Jayakrishna; Mohanty, Priyesh; Dos Passos, Patricia M; Mercado Ortiz, Jose F; Bai, Leanna; Viswanathan, Renjith; Zaborowksy, Julia; Wang, Szu-Huan; Johnson, Victoria; Mamede, Lohany D; Titus, Amanda R; Ayala, Yuna M; Ghirlando, Rodolfo; Mittal, Jeetain; Fawzi, Nicolas L
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR、AlphaFold2-Multimer和全原子MD模拟研究TDP-43 C端结构域螺旋多聚化，属于蛋白质-DNA互作相关蛋白（TDP-43）的结构与动态机制，但未直接聚焦TF-DNA结合位点或互作界面，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Pathological inclusions of the C-terminal domain (CTD) of TAR DNA binding protein-43 (TDP-43) are neurodegenerative hallmarks in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia, yet CTD's aggregation propensity complicates structural characterization of native TDP-43. Here we propose structural models for the physiological multimerization of TDP-43 CTD's conserved region (CR) essential for TDP-43 RNA processing. Using NMR spectroscopy, we establish that the native state of TDP-43 CR at physiological conditions is alpha-helical. Hydrophobic residues drive CR helix-helix assembly, phase separation, and TDP-43 nuclear retention, while polar residues down regulate these processes. An integrative approach combining analytical ultracentrifugation, NMR-derived contacts, AlphaFold2-Multimer modeling, and all-atom molecular dynamics simulations together suggest that TDP-43 CR forms dynamic, multimeric helical assemblies stabilized by a methionine-rich core with specific contributions from a tryptophan/leucine pair. These structures show how ALS-associated mutations disrupt TDP-43 function and provide pharmacologically targetable structures to prevent its conversion into pathogenic beta-sheet aggregates.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白-43（TDP-43）C末端结构域（CTD）的病理性包涵体是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆中的神经退行性标志，然而CTD的聚集倾向使天然TDP-43的结构表征复杂化。在此，我们提出TDP-43 CTD保守区域（CR）生理性多聚化的结构模型，该区域对TDP-43 RNA加工至关重要。利用核磁共振波谱（NMR spectroscopy），我们确定在生理条件下TDP-43 CR的天然状态为α-螺旋。疏水残基驱动CR螺旋-螺旋组装、相分离（phase separation）和TDP-43核滞留，而极性残基则下调这些过程。结合分析超速离心、NMR衍生的接触信息、AlphaFold2-Multimer建模和全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟的综合方法共同表明，TDP-43 CR形成动态的多聚体螺旋组装体，由富含甲硫氨酸的核心稳定，并伴有色氨酸/亮氨酸对的特异性贡献。这些结构揭示了ALS相关突变如何破坏TDP-43功能，并提供了可药理学靶向的结构，以防止其转化为致病性β-折叠聚集体。
